title: MagicBook
description: Discover a mysterious new ore that will allow you to create runes and craft a book that will absorb the inserted component.
body:
MagicBook

MagicBook introduces a world of arcane mysteries and powerful discoveries.
Unearth a new magical ore that holds ancient energy capable of creating runes and the legendary Magic Book.

Each rune has a unique active power, with limited uses. One special rune allows the crafting of the Magic Book — an artifact capable of transformation and adaptation.

Features:

The Magic Book and its 74 transformations

14 new mobs

1 powerful boss

9 runes with active abilities and 1 crafting rune

3 unique dimensions

3 new ores

2 new structures

5 special enchantments

And many more hidden secrets to discover

Forge your path through new worlds, uncover runic power, and master the art of magic with MagicBook.
